example_sentences_in_bangla: সে প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে গিয়ে হচ্ছে হবে করে সময় নষ্ট করছে।
বৈঠকে সকলে হচ্ছে হবে বলে কথা টেনে নিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is wasting time by going on with 'it's happening, it will be' instead of answering the question directly.
In the meeting, everyone dragged the discussion by saying 'it's in process, it will happen.'
note: Refers to drawn-out speech or actions without resolution, common in Bengali oral traditions.
